label: meaningful
label_meaning: meaningful: built from the seller's own published schema

check_type.description: The check contract used, e.g. web_field_presence_v1.

confidence.description: The engine's confidence in the verdict, 0 to 1.

engine.description: Engine name and version digest that produced the verdict.

lens_votes.description: Boolean votes is_real, is_current from the judging lenses.

refetch_excerpt.description: Excerpt of the re-fetched page content the verdict was judged against.

refetched_at.description: UTC timestamp of the engine's own fetch of the page.

key_id.description: Identifier of the signing key; resolve against GET /pubkey.

reasons.description: The stated reasons for the verdict.

signature.description: ed25519 signature over canonical sorted-key JSON of every field except signature.

source_hash.description: sha256 of the normalized page text the verdict judged; null when no anchor text was obtained.

verdict_id.description: Unique identifier for this verdict; its issuance is confirmable at GET /verdicts/{verdict_id}.

verifier_url.description: The issuing service's URL; display only, never a trust root.

attribution.derived_from: the schema and example output the seller publicly lists there
attribution.status: unclaimed: the owner can claim or remove the matching listing on the discovery board
